# #326 — Enforce a whole-pack budget

## Summary

Cap total context-pack size and deterministically allocate or truncate budget across sections so one large section cannot starve higher-value context.

**Workstream key:** `CONTEXT-1`  
**Priority:** P0  
**Parent:** #325  
**Depends on:** #324

## Scope

- Introduce a configurable total pack budget.
- Define and document deterministic section allocation order.
- Mark predictable truncation without exposing content in telemetry.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The configured budget is enforced across the assembled pack rather than independently per section.
- [ ] Allocation order and truncation behavior are deterministic and documented.
- [ ] Existing `working_set`, `recovery`, and `durable_lane_context` behavior remains compatible under the new budget.

## Validation

- [ ] Test oversized inputs and assert total output never exceeds the configured budget.
- [ ] Repeat the same assembly inputs and assert stable section allocation and truncation.
- [ ] Vary individual section sizes and verify higher-priority allocations are preserved.

## Non-goals

- Implementing the six missing section data sources.
- Changing client-side prompt placement.

## Standing constraints

- Exact namespace and session-scope isolation remains a security boundary.
- Prompt placement stays client/runtime-owned; no implicit MCP `_meta` injection.
- Observability remains content-free.
- Dream planning remains dry-run-safe unless a separately authorized mutating wrapper is used.
